policy: Only publish high-level non-proprietary aggregate reports after independent verification and explicit publication approval. Required per item: verified=true, approvedForPublication=true, date YYYY-MM-DD, mode backtest/demo/live, verification source description, summary in all 14 website languages. No raw trades, position sizes, account/broker credentials, balances, order history, proprietary parameters, unpublished backtest results or personally identifying data. Equity curve values must be aggregate returns and all points from a single disclosed trading mode.
